title: Custom aerial platforms
description: Custom aerial platforms designed, built and integrated by the group for sensing, exploration, deployment and multimodal robotics research.
introduction: Alongside algorithms and methods, we have built considerable experience designing, building and integrating aerial platforms for research.
context: Our work spans rolling and trimodal vehicles, deployment platforms and sensing systems. It brings together airframe and mechanism design, sensor integration, onboard computing and flight testing.
galleryIntroduction: A collection of our custom builds, research integrations and flight-test configurations.

collaboration.heading: A platform for your next experiment
collaboration.text: We welcome collaborations on aerial platforms, custom sensing configurations and joint experiments. Get in touch to discuss what your research needs.

sourceReference: S12: the platform images and accompanying narrative supplied by Meysam Basiri on 10 November 2026.
editorQuestions: Confirm preferred names for the unnamed platform configurations. Current captions describe the visible hardware without inferring performance, availability or a unique platform count.

The embedded alternative text references F450 and QAV250 commercial airframes for two images. Confirm preferred attribution and custom-integration descriptions; do not imply every base airframe is an original group design.
